blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Token-level differentially private (DP) prompt optimization methods such as DP-OPT can become unstable under tight privacy budgets: on GSM8K, DP-OPT obtains 49.5 ± 28.5 % 49.5{\pm}28.5\% across 30 runs, and a logged search trajectory reveals prompt-template drift and noise-sensitive irreversible choices. We diagnose these as structural consequences of greedy token-by-token construction over privately aggregated counts. We then propose DP-ES (Differentially Private Evolution Strategies), a structurally cleaner alternative that maintains a population of full prompts, mutates them via LLM calls that never access the private dataset, and spends privacy only on sampled-Gaussian evaluation; deterministic or Gumbel-smoothed selection is post-processing. Under a conservative ( ε ≤ 1.0 , δ = 10 − 5 ) (\varepsilon{\leq}1.0,\delta{=}10^{-5}) guarantee, DP-ES achieves 88.1% on GSM8K (+38.6 pp over DP-OPT, ∼ \sim 9 × \times lower std), 99.7% on MedQA , 73.5% on BANKING77 , and 86.8% on Alpaca . It is also 2.5 × \times faster in wall-clock time and uses 3.3 × \times fewer logged private-data call groups than DP-OPT. Selection and population ablations, implementation-level noise checks, and a 200-profile exact-match memorization stress test complement the formal guarantee. Scope. Our experiments establish optimization robustness under DP noise, especially where prompt structure is critical; end-to-end validation on genuinely sensitive, non-saturated deployment data remains future work. Code: github.com/StephCpa/dp-es .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities through in-context learning Brown et al. (2020) ; Ouyang et al. (2022) , yet their performance heavily relies on carefully crafted prompts Liu et al. (2023) . Automatic prompt optimization Yuksekgonul et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024b) can bridge this gap, but when the optimization data are sensitive (e.g., patient records, financial logs), the optimizer can memorize and expose private information, as evidenced by recent membership inference and extraction attacks Wang et al. (2023) ; Shanmugarasa et al. (2025) ; Fu et al. (2023) . For instance, a naive optimizer might generate a prompt like “Remember how patient #12847 had atrial fibrillation…” , directly violating privacy. Any optimizer intended for such settings must therefore satisfy formal Differential Privacy (DP) guarantees Dwork et al. (2006) —and, crucially, the optimization mechanism itself must remain robust under the noise that DP introduces, which is the question we focus on in this work.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)通过内文学习布朗等(2020年);欧阳等(2022年)展现出卓越的能力,然而其性能却严重依赖于精心设计的提示刘等(2023年). 自动即时优化Yuksekgonul等 (2024) ; Yang等 (2024b) 可以弥补这一差距,但当优化数据敏感(如患者记录,财务日志)时,优化者可以记住并曝光私人信息,最近的成员推论和提取攻击Wang等 (2023) ; Shanmugarasa等 (2025); Fu等 (2023). 例如,一个天真优化者可能会产生类似“记住#12847病人是如何发生审判性纤维化......”的提示,直接侵犯隐私。 因此,任何针对这种环境的优化器都必须满足正式的区别隐私(DP)保障Dwork等人(2006年)的要求,而且至关重要的是,优化机制本身必须在DP引入的噪音下保持强大,这正是我们在这项工作中重点关注的问题。

blocks.en: The Challenge: Task Complexity and Privacy Budgets. Applying DP to prompt optimization is non-trivial due to the discrete nature of text. Recent work like DP-OPT Hong et al. (2024) uses histogram-based token generation with the exponential mechanism. Other approaches apply DP to in-context learning via private few-shot generation or nearest neighbor retrieval Tang et al. (2024) ; Koskela et al. (2025) , but they rely on additional retrieval or embedding machinery. While DP-OPT is effective on simple tasks, it is unstable on our complex-reasoning setting: across 30 GSM8K runs it obtains 49.5 ± 28.5 % 49.5{\pm}28.5\% , and trajectory analysis reveals prompt-template drift and noise-sensitive irreversible decisions (Appendix C.2 ). This fragility is consistent with token-level myopia and non-backtracking search under tight privacy constraints.
blocks.zh: 挑战:任务复杂和隐私预算。 由于文本的离散性质,应用DP来快速优化是非三角的. 最近的工作如DP-OPT Hong等. (2024)使用以直方图为基础的有指数机制的代号生成. 其他方法将DP应用于通过私自的几发相机生成或最近的邻接取回Tang等人(2024年);Koskela等人(2025年)进行内文本学习,但它们依赖于额外的取回或嵌入机械. 虽然DP-OPT在简单的任务上是有效的,但对于我们的复杂推理设置却不稳定:在30个GSM8K运行中,它得到49.5±28.5%49.5⁄pm}28.5\%,轨迹分析揭示出即时流出和对噪音敏感的不可逆决定(附录C.2. 这种脆弱性与象征性水平的近视和在严格的隐私限制下不回溯搜索是一致的.

blocks.en: Private Evolution Perspective. Private Evolution (PE) is a training-free DP paradigm for data synthesis via APIs Lin et al. (2024) ; Xie et al. (2024) ; Lin et al. (2025) . Its core advantage is structural: only low-sensitivity evaluation touches private data, while exploration/generation and selection over privatized scores are post-processing. This yields a decoupling between exploration and privacy expenditure—increasing the number or strength of mutations improves search without consuming additional privacy budget. DP-ES is a prompt-optimization instantiation of this PE principle.
blocks.zh: 私人进化视角. Private Evolution(PE)是数据合成的无培训DP范式,通过APIs Lin等 (2024).;Xie等 (2024).;Lin等 (2025). 其核心优势是结构性的:只有低敏感度的评价触及私人数据,而探索/生成和选择超过私有化分数则是后处理. 这使得勘探支出与隐私支出脱钩——增加突变的数量或强度——在不消耗额外隐私预算的情况下改进了搜索。 DP-ES是这种PE原则的即时优化.

blocks.en: Our Contribution: DP-ES. We frame this work as a diagnostic and methodological contribution for DP prompt optimization: we systematically characterize the instability mechanisms of token-level DP construction under tight privacy budgets and propose Differentially Private Evolution Strategies (DP-ES) , a structurally cleaner alternative. Unlike methods that build prompts token by token from privately aggregated counts, DP-ES maintains a population of full prompts that evolve over time. The key design choice is to decouple exploration from privacy consumption: using LLMs to generate semantic mutations consumes zero privacy budget (by the post-processing property), allowing the scarce privacy budget to be allocated strictly to sampled-Gaussian evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献:DP-ES。 我们把这项工作作为及时优化DP的诊断和方法性贡献:我们系统地将象征性的DP结构在严格的隐私预算下产生的不稳定机制定性为一种结构上更清洁的替代方案,并提出差别化的私人进化战略。 与通过私人汇总计数以象征性方式建立提示的方法不同,DP-ES保持了随时间推移而演变的全提示人口. 关键的设计选择是将探索与隐私消费脱钩:使用LLMS生成语义突变消耗了零隐私预算(由后处理属性),允许将稀缺的隐私预算严格分配给抽样-高斯评价.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. Instability diagnosis: A 30-run analysis of DP-OPT on GSM8K, complemented by a concrete logged trajectory that exposes prompt-template drift and noise-sensitive irreversible selection in token-level construction (Section 5 ). 2. Method: A structurally cleaner evolution-based DP prompt optimizer with privacy-free mutations, sampled-Gaussian scoring under RDP accounting, and deterministic or Gumbel-smoothed post-processing selection. 3. Empirical robustness: ∼ \sim 9 × \times lower standard deviation than DP-OPT on GSM8K, plus strong or competitive results on MedQA, BANKING77, and Alpaca under a conservative ( ε ≤ 1 , δ = 10 − 5 ) (\varepsilon{\leq}1,\delta{=}10^{-5}) guarantee. 4. Efficiency: 2.5 × \times faster wall-clock runtime and 3.3 × \times fewer logged private-data call groups than DP-OPT on GSM8K, with an explicit generation-vs-evaluation cost decomposition. 5. Privacy evidence: A reproducible RDP accounting calculation and noise-distribution checks, plus a 200-profile synthetic exact-match stress test (0 PII strings found for DP-ES vs. 40 for an adversarial non-DP control).

blocks.en: Scope of Empirical Evidence. Our experiments establish DP-ES as a structurally more robust DP prompt optimizer than token-level alternatives, especially on tasks where prompt structure is critical. They do not by themselves validate deployment on genuinely sensitive, non-saturated datasets. The formal ( ε , δ ) (\varepsilon,\delta) -DP guarantee bounds record-level leakage independently of the benchmark, while the implementation checks and exact-match stress test provide complementary diagnostics. We make these scope boundaries explicit in the Limitations section.
blocks.zh: 经验证据的范围。 我们的实验将DP-ES确立为一个结构上比象征性的替代方法更强大的DP快速优化器,特别是在快速结构至关重要的任务方面。 它们本身并不能验证在真正敏感、不饱和的数据集上的部署。 正式的( ,δ)(\varepsilon,\delta)-DP保证将记录级渗出独立于基准,而执行检查和精确匹配的压力测试则提供辅助诊断. 我们在限制部分明确了这些范围界限。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prompt Optimization. Gradient-free methods such as APE Zhou et al. (2023) and OPRO Yang et al. (2024b) search over discrete prompt candidates using LLM-generated variations, while gradient-based approaches like TextGrad Yuksekgonul et al. (2024) use LLM feedback as differentiable signals. Both families optimize prompts effectively but assume unrestricted access to training data with no privacy guarantees Edemacu and Wu (2025) , making them unsuitable for sensitive domains such as healthcare, finance, and education where data protection is legally mandated.
blocks.zh: 快速优化。 由APE Zhou等人(2023年)和OPRO Yang等人(2024年b年)利用LLM产生的变异在离散的即时候选人上进行搜索,而由TextGrad Yuksekgonul等人(2024年)等梯度法将LLM反馈作为可分的信号. 两个家庭都优化了有效激励,但承担了不受限制地获取培训数据的机会,没有隐私保障,Edemacu和Wu(2025年),使它们不适合敏感领域,如保健、财务和教育,因为数据保护是法律规定的。

blocks.en: Differential Privacy in Machine Learning. DP-SGD Abadi et al. (2016) and PATE Papernot et al. (2018) provide formal ( ε , δ ) (\varepsilon,\delta) -DP guarantees for continuous model parameters during training. DP-LoRA Liu et al. (2024b) ; Frery et al. (2025) extends this to parameter-efficient fine-tuning of LLMs, achieving strong performance with reduced memory overhead. However, all these methods require access to model weights, precluding their use with black-box API-only LLMs—the dominant deployment mode for state-of-the-art models such as GPT-4 and DeepSeek.

blocks.en: DP Prompt Optimization. For discrete prompts over black-box LLMs, DP-OPT Hong et al. (2024) uses histogram-based token generation with the exponential mechanism, constructing prompts token by token from privately aggregated counts. While effective on classification and factual QA, this greedy token-level approach is unstable in our GSM8K experiments and can exhibit prompt-template drift and noise-sensitive irreversible decisions (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: DP 即时优化. 适用于黑盒LLMs上的离散提示,DP-OPT Hong等. (2024)使用以直方图为基础的有指数机制的符号生成,从私人汇总计数中逐一地构建出提示符. 这种贪婪的象征水平方法虽然对分类和事实质量评估有效,但在我们的GSM8K实验中是不稳定的,并且可以迅速显示流出和噪声敏感不可逆转的决定(第5节)。

blocks.en: Other Approaches. Other directions include DP few-shot demonstration generation for in-context learning Tang et al. (2024) , which privately selects exemplars but cannot optimize the instruction prompt itself; private retrieval augmentation Koskela et al. (2025) , which protects retrieval queries but inherits the limitations of fixed prompt templates; and PromptDPSGD Duan et al. (2023) , which applies DP-SGD to continuous soft prompt embeddings but requires white-box model access and struggles on smaller models (Appendix C.3 ).
blocks.zh: 其他办法。 其他方向包括DP几发演示生成用于内文学习的Tang等 (2024) ,其中私人选择了示例,但不能优化指令的快取本身;私人检索增强Koskela等 (2025),保护检索查询但继承了固定即时模板的局限性;和PournalDPSGD Duan等 (2023),其中应用DP-SGD来持续软即时嵌入,但要求白盒模型访问和在更小模型上挣扎(附录C.3).

blocks.en: Private Evolution. Private Evolution (PE) Lin et al. (2024) ; Xie et al. (2024) ; Lin et al. (2025) is a training-free DP framework originally developed for data synthesis via APIs. Its key structural advantage is that only a low-sensitivity evaluation step touches private data, while API-based generation is pure post-processing. This creates a favorable decoupling: exploration can be arbitrarily rich without consuming privacy budget. DP-ES adapts this principle from data synthesis to prompt optimization, inheriting the favorable privacy-exploration trade-off while introducing population-based search over the discrete prompt space.
blocks.zh: 私人进化. Private Evolution (PE) Lin等 (2024) ; Xie等 (2024) ; Lin等 (2025) 是一款为通过API进行数据合成而最初开发的免费DP框架. 它的关键结构优势是,只有低灵敏度的评价步骤会触及到私人数据,而基于API的生成则是纯后处理. 这造成了一种有利的脱钩:探索可以任意地丰富而无需消耗隐私预算. DP-ES将这一原则从数据合成到即时优化,继承了有利的隐私探索取舍,同时在离散的即时空间上引入基于人口的搜索.

blocks.en: Evolution Strategies and DP. Evolution strategies (ES) Rechenberg (1973) are derivative-free algorithms that maintain and evolve populations of candidate solutions. Prior non-private prompt optimizers, including EvoPrompt Guo et al. (2024) and PromptBreeder Fernando et al. (2023) , already use LLM-driven mutation and population-based selection to optimize discrete prompts. DP-ES builds on this evolutionary-prompt-optimization line while introducing record-level DP through sampled-Gaussian scoring and post-processing selection. The population-based design provides natural robustness to noise-induced regressions—a critical advantage under tight privacy budgets where evaluation noise is substantial.
blocks.zh: 进化策略与DP. 进化策略 (ES) Rechenberg (1973) 是维持和演化候选解决方案群的无衍生算法. 先前的非私人即时优化器,包括EvoPrompt Guo等 (2024)和FourceBreeder Fernando等 (2023),已经使用由LLM驱动的突变和基于人口的选择来优化离散快取. DP-ES以这一进化-即时-优化线为基础,同时通过抽样-高士分和后处理选择引入了记录级DP. 以人口为基础的设计为噪音引起的回归提供了自然的稳健性,这是在严格的隐私预算下的一个关键优势,因为评估噪音很大。

blocks.en: Privacy Auditing. Empirical privacy attacks and audits can reveal implementation errors but cannot certify DP from a finite number of trials Nasr et al. (2021) ; Jagielski et al. (2020) . We therefore base our guarantee on mechanism-level RDP accounting and use noise checks and an exact-match memorization stress test only as complementary diagnostics (Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 隐私审计。 经验性隐私攻击和审计可以揭示执行错误,但无法通过有限的Nasr等人案(2021年)验证DP;Jagielski等人案(2020年). 因此,我们以机制层面的RDP核算为基础,并以噪音检查和精确匹配的记忆压力测试作为补充诊断(第6节)。

blocks.en: Positioning of DP-ES. Table 1 summarizes the landscape. DP-ES uniquely combines evolutionary exploration with sampled-Gaussian scoring and post-processing selection, filling the gap for a robust, black-box-compatible DP prompt optimization method that scales across diverse task complexities—from structured classification to multi-step reasoning.

blocks.en: Problem Formulation. Let 𝒟 = { ( x i , y i ) } i = 1 n \mathcal{D}=\{(x_{i},y_{i})\}_{i=1}^{n} be a private dataset where x i x_{i} represents task inputs and y i y_{i} represents desired outputs (e.g., question-answer pairs). blocks.en: Privacy-Free Mutations. Key Innovation: Unlike gradient-based methods that require DP protection for gradient computation, DP-ES sends only a public or previously privatized parent prompt to the mutation LLM; neither records from 𝒟 \mathcal{D} nor record-derived feedback are included. Mutation is therefore post-processing and consumes zero additional privacy budget.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented a diagnostic and methodological contribution for differentially private prompt optimization. On the diagnostic side, a 30-run analysis shows substantial DP-OPT instability on GSM8K, while a logged trajectory exposes prompt-template drift and noise-sensitive irreversible decisions in token-level construction. On the methodological side, we introduced DP-ES , a structurally cleaner evolution-based alternative that maintains a population of full prompts, mutates them without exposing private records, and restricts privacy expenditure to sampled-Gaussian scoring; selection over privatized scores is post-processing.
blocks.zh: 我们为差别化的私人快速优化提供了诊断和方法方面的贡献。 在诊断方面,一项30个运行的分析显示,GSM8K的DP-OPT不稳定性相当大,而记录的轨迹则暴露出在符号级构造中瞬间流出和噪声敏感不可逆的决定. 在方法方面,我们引入了DP-ES, 一个结构上更清洁的基于进化的替代方案, 它保持了全速率的人群, 在不暴露私人记录的情况下进行突变, 并将隐私开支限制在抽取的-Gausian分数中; 超过私有化分数的选择是后处理。

blocks.en: Across four tasks—GSM8K (88.1%), MedQA (99.7%), BANKING77 (73.5%), and Alpaca (86.8%, LLM-judge)—DP-ES matches or exceeds DP-OPT under a conservative ε ≤ 1 \varepsilon\leq 1 guarantee, with ∼ \sim 9 × \times lower variance on GSM8K, 2.5 × \times faster wall-clock runtime, and 3.3 × \times fewer logged private-data call groups. Deterministic and Gumbel-smoothed selection have comparable utility and identical privacy guarantees because both post-process privatized scores. Noise-distribution checks and a 200-profile exact-match memorization stress test provide complementary diagnostics alongside the formal RDP accounting.

blocks.en: Scope. The strongest evidence we provide is for optimization robustness under DP noise on benchmarks where prompt structure matters , with the largest gains on reasoning-heavy tasks where token-level construction is most brittle. End-to-end validation on genuinely sensitive, non-saturated deployment data—which would require benchmarks combining record-level sensitivity with non-trivial semantic reasoning—remains future work and is the most direct extension of this contribution.
blocks.zh: 范围。 我们提供的最有力的证据是,在DP噪声下,在迅速结构至关重要的基准上,优化稳健性,在象征性建筑最简陋的推理繁重任务上,进展最大。 对真正敏感、不饱和的部署数据进行端到端的验证——这需要把记录水平的敏感性与非三角语义推理结合起来的基准——仍然是今后的工作,是这一贡献最直接的延伸。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We are explicit about the boundaries of what this work establishes.
blocks.zh: 我们明确了这项工作的界限。

blocks.en: Empirical Scope: No Sensitive-Data Deployment Validation. Our experiments establish that DP-ES is a structurally more robust DP prompt optimizer than token-level alternatives on benchmarks where prompt structure matters. They do not validate end-to-end deployment on genuinely sensitive, non-saturated datasets (e.g., real clinical records, financial logs). Such validation would require benchmarks that combine record-level sensitivity with non-trivial semantic reasoning, which the current public benchmark landscape does not provide. The formal ( ε , δ ) (\varepsilon,\delta) -DP guarantee, by construction, bounds record-level leakage independent of the benchmark, but a direct sensitive-data deployment study remains future work.
blocks.zh: 经验范围:没有敏感数据部署验证。 我们的实验证实,DP-ES在结构上比标杆级替代方法更能优化迅速结构的基准。 它们不会在真正敏感,不饱和的数据集(如真实临床记录,财务日志)上验证端到端的部署. 这种验证将需要将记录层次敏感性与非三角语义推理相结合的基准,而目前的公共基准景观没有提供这些基准。 正式的(ε,δ) (\varepsilon,\delta) - DP通过建筑保证将记录水平的渗出独立于基准,但直接的敏感数据部署研究仍然是今后的工作.

blocks.en: MedQA Ceiling Effect. DP-ES reaches 99.7% on the 200-question MedQA subset, with the Non-DP baseline saturating at 100.0 ± \pm 0.0. This near-ceiling performance limits the discriminative power of MedQA for studying privacy-utility trade-offs at ε = 1.0 \varepsilon{=}1.0 ; the 6.2 pp improvement over DP-OPT on this saturated regime is informative but should not be over-interpreted as evidence for a non-trivial privacy-utility frontier on medical QA more broadly. A non-saturated medical benchmark (e.g., a harder open-ended clinical reasoning task) would provide stronger evidence.
blocks.zh: MedQA 上限效应. DP-ES在200个问题 MedQA子集上达到99.7%,非DP基线饱和度为100.0±\pm 0.0. 这种近乎最高的性能限制了MedQA在QQ=1.0\varepsilon=1.0研究隐私-实用性取舍方面的歧视性权力;6.2页在这种饱和制度上比DP-OPT的改进是翔实的,但不应该被过度地解释为更广泛地解释医学QA上的非三角隐私-实用性前沿的证据. 非饱和医疗基准(例如,更难完成的开放式临床推理任务)将提供更强有力的证据。

blocks.en: Privacy Attack Coverage. The 200-profile synthetic memorization stress test (Section 6 ) measures direct or near-verbatim sensitive-string leakage against an intentionally adversarial non-DP control. It does not test paraphrased memorization, rare-attribute disclosure, record reconstruction, or membership inference. Moreover, the mutation LLM can reproduce information already present in its parametric memory; DP-ES bounds the incremental influence of the private optimization dataset, not memorization inherited from pretraining. The formal ( ε , δ ) (\varepsilon,\delta) -DP guarantee is attack-agnostic, but a direct empirical attack suite comparing DP-ES against DP-OPT under matched bounds would provide useful complementary evidence and remains future work.

Efficiency Reporting Scope. The cost decomposition by call purpose (Appendix C.1 , Table 7 ) is from a representative single-seed run on a 200-sample validation set. Aggregate wall-clock numbers across the full 1,319-sample test set are reported separately (Table 6 ); token-level and call-purpose splits at full aggregate scale are not yet released. We report the most granular reproducible numbers we have and treat aggregate token-level reporting as future work.

blocks.en: Task Diversity. We evaluate on four tasks (GSM8K, MedQA, BANKING77, Alpaca) covering math reasoning, medical QA, intent classification, and instruction-following. Additional benchmarks (e.g., summarization, code generation, open-ended clinical reasoning) would further characterize cross-domain generalization.
blocks.zh: 任务多样性。 我们评价四项任务(GSM8K、MedQA、Banking77、Alpaca),包括数学推理、医学质量评估、意图分类和教学跟踪。 其他基准(如汇总、代码生成、开放的临床推理)将进一步说明跨域通用的特点。

blocks.en: Task-Dependent Advantage. DP-ES’s strongest gains over DP-OPT are on complex reasoning tasks (GSM8K: +38.6 pp, MedQA: +6.2 pp). On well-structured classification (BANKING77) and instruction-following (Alpaca), both methods perform comparably, suggesting that DP-ES’s population-based exploration is most beneficial when the prompt search space is large and structured prompts are critical.
blocks.zh: 任务依赖优势. DP-ES对DP-OPT最强的收获在于复杂的推理任务(GSM8K:+38.6页,MedQA:+6.2页). 在结构完善的分类(BANKING77)和遵循指令(Alpaca)方面,这两种方法都具有可比性,表明DP-ES基于人口的探索在快速搜索空间大而结构化的提示至关重要的情况下最为有益。

blocks.en: Privacy Budget Sweeps. Our verified experiments establish the common conservative bound ε ≤ 1 \varepsilon\leq 1 rather than a densely sampled privacy–utility frontier. Re-running all methods with noise recalibrated to several exact RDP targets would better characterize the trade-off.
blocks.zh: 隐私预算扫描。 我们经过验证的实验 建立了共同的保守约束 \\\ 1\ varepsilon\leq 1 而不是一个密集的样本 隐私 - 实用性前沿。 以噪音重新调整所有方法,使之达到若干确切的RDP目标,将更好地说明权衡的特征。

blocks.en: Theoretical Analysis of Task Complexity. We empirically observe that task complexity is a key determinant of the success of DP optimization. A formal theoretical framework linking prompt search space characteristics to privacy budget requirements is still needed.
blocks.zh: 任务复杂性理论分析. 我们从经验上观察到,任务的复杂性是衡量DP优化成功与否的关键决定因素。 仍然需要一个正式的理论框架,将迅速搜索空间的特点与隐私预算要求联系起来。

blocks.en: Future Work. Beyond the scope items above, promising directions include adaptive population sizing, multi-objective optimization (utility, privacy, stability), and federated DP-ES for distributed sensitive data settings.
blocks.zh: 未来活计. 除上述范围项目外,有希望的方向包括适应人口规模、多目标优化(效用、隐私、稳定性)和为分布式敏感数据设置而联合的DP-ES。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work develops differentially private (DP) prompt-optimization mechanisms motivated by settings where the underlying optimization data may be sensitive. Our empirical evaluation is conducted on public benchmarks; the considerations below concern both this study and any downstream use of the released method.
blocks.zh: 这项工作发展了差别化的私人(DP)快速优化机制,其动机是基础优化数据可能敏感的环境。 我们对公共基准进行实证评估;以下考虑既涉及这项研究,也涉及释放方法的任何下游使用。

blocks.en: Privacy Scope: DP-ES provides formal ( ε , δ \varepsilon,\delta )-DP guarantees for prompt optimization under correct implementation and accounting. The reported implementation diagnostics and exact-match stress test do not certify DP or cover downstream deployment risks beyond the mechanism.
blocks.zh: 隐私范围:DP-ES为及时优化提供正式的(QQ, \ varepsilon,\delta)-DP保障,同时正确执行和核算. 所报告的执行诊断和精确匹配的压力测试不能证明DP或涵盖机制以外的下游部署风险。

blocks.en: Data Use: We use public benchmarks and do not collect new personal data. Applications to real sensitive data should follow institutional review, access control, and data governance requirements.
blocks.zh: 数据使用 : 我们使用公共基准,不收集新的个人数据。 实际敏感数据的应用应遵循机构审查、访问控制和数据治理要求。

blocks.en: Dual-Use Concerns: As with any optimization technique, DP-ES could be misused to refine harmful applications. Responsible deployment should include access control, monitoring, and safety filtering.
blocks.zh: 双重用途问题: 与任何优化技术一样,DP-ES也可能被滥用来完善有害的应用. 负责的部署应包括出入控制、监测和安全过滤。

blocks.en: Transparency and Reproducibility: We provide code and privacy accounting details to enable verification of claims and independent audits.
blocks.zh: 透明度和可复制性: 我们提供代码和隐私会计细节,以便能够核查索赔和独立审计。

blocks.en: A.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: A.1 数据集

blocks.en: GSM8K Cobbe et al. (2021) : Grade school math word problems requiring multi-step arithmetic reasoning. We use the full official test set of 1,319 examples from the original benchmark for final evaluation. During prompt optimization, we use a separate 200-example validation subset to compute fitness scores, ensuring that no test data leakage occurs. Problems involve operations like addition, multiplication, and percentages. Success requires prompts that guide the step-by-step generation of solutions.
blocks.zh: GSM8K (英语). Cobbe等人(2021年) : 年级数学词问题需要多步算术推理. 我们使用原基准1 319个例子的全套正式测试集进行最后评估。 在即时优化期间,我们使用单独的200实例验证子集来计算健身分数,确保不发生测试数据泄漏. 问题涉及增加、乘数和百分比等业务。 成功需要指导逐步产生解决办法的提示。

blocks.en: MedQA Jin et al. (2021) : Medical question answering from the USMLE exam. We use 200 questions covering disease diagnosis, treatment, and pathophysiology. Evaluation uses choice-only accuracy on this 200-question subset; we do not fine-tune model weights (prompt-only optimization), avoiding training-set leakage. This task probes performance on a specialized domain and high-accuracy regimes.
blocks.zh: MedQA Jin等人(2021年): 医疗问题从USMLE检查中解答. 我们使用200个问题,包括疾病诊断、治疗和病理。 评价在这个200个问题子集上使用只选择的精度;我们不微调模型权重(即时-仅优化),避免了训练-所设置的漏洞. 这项任务考察了在一个专门领域和高度精确制度中的表现。

blocks.en: BANKING77 Casanueva et al. (2020) : Fine-grained intent classification with 77 banking-related intent categories (e.g., card_arrival , exchange_rate , lost_or_stolen_card ). We use 200 randomly sampled examples for evaluation. This task tests DP-ES on a classification problem with a large label space, where prompt optimization must convey category structure without memorizing individual examples.

blocks.en: Alpaca Taori et al. (2023) : Open-ended instruction-following evaluated by an LLM judge. We use 200 instructions sampled from the Alpaca evaluation set. Quality is scored on a [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] rubric by DeepSeek-Chat (temperature 0.0, max 64 tokens), assessing instruction adherence, factual accuracy, and response quality. This task represents a fundamentally different evaluation paradigm (generative quality via LLM-judge rather than exact-match accuracy), testing whether DP-ES generalizes beyond closed-form metrics.

blocks.en: DP-OPT (black-box adaptation) Hong et al. (2024) : DP-OPT’s canonical method uses histogram-based token generation with the exponential mechanism. blocks.en: Our privacy guarantees assume:
blocks.zh: 我们的隐私保障假设:

blocks.en: 1. Trusted curator: The party running DP-ES has access to the private dataset 𝒟 \mathcal{D} but releases only the final prompt with DP guarantees. 2. Record-level privacy: The privacy unit is one data record ( x i , y i ) (x_{i},y_{i}) . Group privacy (protecting multiple records per individual) requires scaling ε \varepsilon by group size. 3. Trusted computation boundary: The curator and any model endpoint used for private-data evaluation are trusted processors. The released prompt is protected; DP does not hide API inputs from the provider receiving them. 4. Mutation isolation: The mutation LLM receives only a parent prompt, never records or record-derived text feedback. PII memorized independently in the pretrained model’s parameters is outside this record-level threat model and should be handled by provider safeguards. 5. Post-processing safety: The released prompt may be used by downstream applications without additional loss about 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , although new downstream data require their own privacy analysis.

blocks.en: Root Cause Analysis:
blocks.zh: 根原因分析 :

blocks.en: 1. Token-Level Myopia: DP-OPT generates prompts token by token using a histogram-based exponential mechanism. At each position, it votes on the next token across data partitions. This greedy process lacks global coherence checking, allowing it to: • Omit critical placeholders like {question} during generation • Create syntactically valid but semantically meaningless prompts • Drift toward generic text unrelated to the task
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 Token- Level Myopia : (原始内容存档于2019-09-31) (英语). DP-OPT利用以直方图为基础的指数机制,以符号方式生成提示符. 在每个位置,它都会对下个符号进行投票,通过数据分区. 这种贪婪的过程缺乏全球一致性检查,使得它能够: 将关键占位符像{问题}在一代人中输出出来 ; 创建在战术上有效但显性无意义的提示 ; 向与任务无关的通名文本漂移

blocks.en: 2. Non-Backtracking Search: Once a token is selected, DP-OPT cannot revise it. If early tokens lead to a poor prompt structure, the algorithm is permanently stuck. This contrasts with DP-ES, which maintains a diverse population and can recover from individual poor candidates.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 无备份 搜索 : 一旦选定了一个令牌,DP-OPT就不能修改. 如果早期的令牌导致一个差的即时结构,算法就被永久卡住. 这与DP-ES形成对比,DP-ES维持着不同的人口,可以从个别贫穷候选人中恢复.

blocks.en: 3. Sample-Based Evaluation Noise: DP-OPT evaluates candidates on small samples (typically 10-20 examples). A prompt that performs well by chance on this sample may be selected and propagated, even if it generalizes poorly. DP-ES mitigates this through population diversity—multiple independent candidates reduce the risk of overfitting to evaluation noise.
blocks.zh: 3个 抽样评价 噪音:DP-OPT在小样本上评价候选人(典型的为10-20个实例). 可以选择并推广在样本上偶然发挥良好作用的提示,即使其概括性很差。 DP-ES通过人口多样性——多种独立候选人减少过于适应评价噪音的风险来缓解这种情况。

blocks.en: Noise-sensitive selection. DP noise can reverse the ordering of candidates with similar utility. DP-OPT commits to each token-level decision without backtracking, so an early rank inversion can permanently redirect construction. DP-ES does not eliminate rank inversions; instead, its population retains multiple complete hypotheses and can recover in later rounds.
